name: workforce-hr-readiness
executionConcern: Control Panel HR, Workforce profile/readiness/provisioning, Identity actor linkage, DSH operational assignment consumption and direct Captain/Field gates
objective: Establish one Workforce-owned employment/readiness model and remove duplicate profile/readiness truth from Control Panel, DSH and mobile consumers.
truthOwner: Workforce owns employment/profile/readiness; Identity owns actor/session/permissions; DSH owns only explicit operational assignments/scopes; WLT remains separate financial truth.

tasks.objective: Close HR people/profile/readiness on Workforce canonical state
tasks.currentProblem: Employment/profile/readiness can drift if HR or DSH stores a second authoritative actor profile instead of reading Workforce.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace HR people/profile/status/supervisor/shift/evidence operations through Workforce contracts/backend/database; enforce permissions/object scope and canonical readback, with Identity actor IDs as references only.
tasks.targetState: Every HR record and readiness decision comes from Workforce, while authentication/permissions remain Identity-owned and DSH consumes only explicit operational facts.
tasks.action: Repair Workforce owner persistence/bindings, migrate HR controllers and delete obsolete duplicate profile/readiness state after consumers move.
mustNotChange: Do not copy Identity credentials/session truth into Workforce.
Do not copy WLT wallet/commission truth into Workforce.
Do not trust browser-selected employee/scope context without server authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: HR list/detail/update paths read/write Workforce canonical state.
Suspended/incomplete/missing readiness fails explicitly where the contract requires it.
Identity actor linkage and DSH operational scope remain referential rather than duplicated.
tasks.rollback: Roll forward at Workforce for persisted profile/readiness state; preserve actor linkage and employment audit evidence.

tasks.objective: Close Captain/Field provisioning and readiness boundary
tasks.currentProblem: A valid Identity session can be confused with employment readiness, or Captain/Field can rely on local profile defaults instead of Workforce state.
tasks.requiredChange: Trace Control Panel provisioning to Identity actor creation/activation plus Workforce profile/readiness and any explicit DSH assignment; update direct Captain/Field consumers to authoritative gates and recovery states.
tasks.targetState: Authentication, employment readiness and operational assignment are separately proven and compose deterministically for Captain/Field access.
tasks.action: Remove local readiness shortcuts, bind direct mobile consumers to canonical owner responses and prove missing/incomplete/suspended/forbidden states.
mustNotChange: Do not grant operational access solely from an Identity role.
Do not create a second employment profile in DSH/mobile state.
Do not broaden into unrelated Captain/Field journeys.
acceptanceCriteria: Missing/incomplete/suspended Workforce state blocks or limits access according to contract.
Valid active Workforce state composes with Identity and explicit DSH assignment without duplicate truth.
Captain/Field direct consumers remain compatible and show canonical recovery states.
tasks.rollback: Revert presentation mapping only if it does not restore an authorization bypass; otherwise roll forward at the canonical owner.
